questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 13 cm and a height of 8 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?
questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 13 × 8 = 52 cm². Say the ½ step out loud before multiplying so it never gets skipped.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 18g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system — atoms are only rearranged, not lost, so the products weigh the same as the reactants: 18g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: Name one sign that tells you a chemical reaction has happened.
questions.why: Signs like a colour change, gas bubbles, a temperature change, or a solid (precipitate) forming all show a new substance has been made.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: Why can a cartoon mascot on a cereal box affect a child's food choice?
questions.answer: It makes the cereal seem fun and exciting
questions.why: Mascots create a fun, likeable feeling around a product, not facts about health — kids often mistake that good feeling for proof the food is actually healthy.
options: It makes the cereal seem fun and exciting
It proves the cereal is low in sugar
It shows the cereal has more vitamins
It guarantees the cereal is fresh

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, what does the '% Daily Intake' column mainly tell you?
questions.answer: How a food fits daily needs
questions.why: The %DI column shows how much one serve contributes toward an average day's nutrient needs, letting you compare foods. Some students confuse it with pack weight or freshness, which aren't shown by that column at all.
options: How a food fits daily needs
The total weight of the pack

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What gas is often seen bubbling off when a chemical reaction happens?
questions.why: Bubbles forming in a reaction usually show a gas such as carbon dioxide, oxygen or hydrogen being produced — a classic visible sign a new substance has formed.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: Why is grilled chicken a healthier choice than fried chicken?
questions.why: Grilling uses little or no oil, so the food absorbs much less fat than frying does — fat content, not vitamins or protein, is the key difference here.
